name: Amanda Hutchinson
prior_offices: Uinta County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official elected officials list and the official election information page)
background: Amanda Hutchinson is the Uinta County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elected officials list and the official election information page name her as clerk. She won the November 2022 general election.
